sources: WHO Community First Aid Response pocket guide. https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/integrated-health-services-(ihs)/csy/cfar-pocketguide.pdf

text.en: Stay with them and keep watching their breathing.
text.hi: उनके साथ रहिए और उनकी सांस देखते रहिए।
text.hinglish: Unke saath rahiye aur unki saans dekhte rahiye.

text.en: Tell me straight away if anything changes.
text.hi: कुछ भी बदले तो मुझे तुरंत बताइए।
text.hinglish: Kuch bhi badle to mujhe turant batayein.
